# Best AI automation agencies in France in 2026

The market for AI automation agencies grew denser in 2026. Here is an honest comparison of the credible players — including us — to help you choose based on your sector, your data and your budget.

Zakaria El AsriJuly 24, 20269 min

The comparison

8 credible AI automation agencies — their specialties, who they're for, and how to choose.

In France in 2026, several AI automation agencies stand out depending on your needs: **Hyperstack** and **Quadia** for complex n8n workflows, **Genee** for hosting and maintenance in France, **Nocode Factory** for no-code + AI, and **Lumyniq** for tailored work in regulated sectors (real estate, legal, healthcare, HR) with GDPR compliance. The right choice depends on your sector, the sensitivity of your data and your budget.

Transparency

## How this list was put together

This comparison is published by Lumyniq, an agency that appears on the list. We own that — and that's precisely why we work hard to be fair: describing each player by its real strength and stating _who_ it's a fit for, rather than arbitrarily placing ourselves at the top. The information comes from public sources (agency websites, sector comparisons) as of the publication date. A market moves fast: always check references and ask for a client case.

Method

## 5 criteria for choosing an AI agency

1. **Demonstrable technical expertise** — real workflows and agents, not just demos.
2. **Verifiable references** — client cases you can cross-check.
3. **Pricing transparency** — a clear costing method, with no grey areas.
4. **Post-deployment support** — monitoring, maintenance, optimization.
5. **Position on hosting and GDPR** — where your data lives, and under what guarantees.

In short

## Overview: the right agency for your need

For those in a hurry, the one-line recommendation card per agency:

- **Lumyniq** — Best for regulated sectors (real estate, legal, healthcare, HR).
- **Hyperstack** — Best for complex n8n workflows with a partner label.
- **Genee** — Best for hosting and maintenance in France.
- **Quadia** — Best for technical CRM/ERP integrations.
- **Nocode Factory** — Best for combining no-code apps and automation.
- **Shunpo** — Best for application development + AI.
- **Juwa** — Best for team support + training.
- **AY Automate** — Best for on-demand embedded (forward-deployed) AI engineers.

Detail

## The agencies, one by one

### [Lumyniq](https://lumyniq.fr/en) Paris

Best for regulated sectors (real estate, legal, healthcare, HR)

AI agents and n8n automation for regulated sectors, with European hosting and GDPR compliance. Covers custom agents, n8n and Claude integration.

**Best for:** SMBs and mid-market companies in sensitive sectors wanting compliant, tailored solutions.

Strengths

- Deep sector specialization (4 regulated sectors) with GDPR / AI Act constraints built in
- European hosting and data governance by default, not as an option
- End-to-end delivery: audit, AI agents, n8n workflows, Claude/OpenAI/Mistral integration

To consider

- Young brand, still a limited base of testimonials
- Not the right choice for a simple, generic no-code workflow

### HyperstackFrance

Best for complex n8n workflows with a partner label

Positions itself as the official n8n Expert partner in France; advanced n8n workflows, AI agents and autonomous systems.

**Best for:** Complex n8n workflows looking for a partner label.

Strengths

- Claimed "n8n Expert Partner" positioning, a signal of specialization
- Focus on advanced workflows and autonomous systems

To consider

- Generalist n8n positioning, less sector-specific grounding

### GeneeFrance

Best for hosting and maintenance in France

An "infrastructure and production" approach: French hosting, maintenance, monitoring, AI agents and clear pricing.

**Best for:** Companies wanting automations hosted and maintained in France.

Strengths

- French hosting and a production mindset (monitoring, maintenance)
- Clear pricing communication

To consider

- Less oriented toward specialized business use cases

### QuadiaFrance

Best for technical CRM/ERP integrations

A highly technical n8n agency focused on complex workflows, self-hosted deployment and CRM/ERP integration.

**Best for:** Technical projects with heavy CRM/ERP integrations.

Strengths

- Strong technical depth on self-hosted n8n
- Good for heavy systems integrations

To consider

- Very technical profile, less business support / training

### Nocode FactoryParis

Best for combining no-code apps and automation

No-code / low-code and AI: apps, sites and Make and n8n workflows, simple or multi-agent setups (OpenAI, Claude, Mistral).

**Best for:** Startups and scale-ups combining no-code apps and automation.

Strengths

- Covers no-code apps + automation in a single partner
- Multi-model (OpenAI, Claude, Mistral)

To consider

- No-code first, less suited to heavy custom systems

### ShunpoLyon

Best for application development + AI

An AI & Tech agency: custom application development and business process automation.

**Best for:** Projects combining application development and AI.

Strengths

- Custom application development skills
- Presence outside Paris (Lyon)

To consider

- Broad positioning, less specialized in pure automation

### JuwaFrance

Best for team support + training

Custom AI solutions for SMBs and mid-market: automation, CRM/ERP integration and team training.

**Best for:** SMBs looking for support + internal training.

Strengths

- Team training component
- Clearly targets SMBs and mid-market

To consider

- Generalist offering, to be qualified against your specific need

### AY AutomateInternational

Best for on-demand embedded (forward-deployed) AI engineers

AI transformation consultancy with a 'forward-deployed engineers' model: embedded engineers who ship complete production systems (Claude Code, n8n, Make, Cursor), backed by a first-month refundable guarantee.

**Best for:** Companies wanting an AI engineering team deployed fast, internationally.

Strengths

- 'Forward-deployed' model: delivers whole systems, not isolated features
- First-month refundable guarantee
- Broad sector coverage (marketing, ecommerce, legal, finance, logistics) — 45+ clients

To consider

- Global positioning rather than a France / regulated-sector specialist
- Custom (retainer) pricing, no public rate card

Our positioning

## Where Lumyniq fits

We're not trying to be « the most generalist AI agency ». Our niche is precise: **AI agents and n8n automation for regulated sectors** — real estate, legal, healthcare, human resources — where compliance, data hosting and traceability matter as much as performance. We cover three building blocks: [custom AI agents](https://lumyniq.fr/en/agent-ia-sur-mesure), [n8n automation](https://lumyniq.fr/en/agence-n8n) and [Claude integration](https://lumyniq.fr/en/integration-claude).

If your need is a generic n8n workflow or a no-code app, other agencies on this list will be just as relevant. If you operate in a sector where a data-handling mistake has regulatory consequences, let's talk.

Decision

## How to choose for your case

Three questions are enough to decide between these AI automation agencies:

- **Is your data sensitive / regulated?** If so (health, legal, finance, customer data), favor an agency with European hosting and native GDPR governance — [Lumyniq](https://lumyniq.fr/en) or Genee.
- **Is your need a technical n8n workflow?** For complex self-hosted setups and heavy CRM/ERP integrations, look at Hyperstack or Quadia. See also our [n8n agency](https://lumyniq.fr/en/agence-n8n) guide.
- **Are you combining no-code apps and AI?** Nocode Factory or Shunpo cover development + automation. For a business-oriented [custom AI agent](https://lumyniq.fr/en/agent-ia-sur-mesure), a specialized agency will be more relevant than a generalist integrator.

One last reflex before you sign: ask for a verifiable client case and a costed estimate. A credible agency answers both without hedging.

FAQ

## Frequently asked questions

What is the best AI automation agency in France in 2026?

There's no single "best" agency in absolute terms: the right choice depends on your sector, your data constraints and your budget. For complex n8n workflows, agencies like Hyperstack or Quadia are strong; for hosting and maintenance in France, Genee; for tailored work in regulated sectors (real estate, legal, healthcare, HR) with GDPR compliance, Lumyniq. Compare on real expertise, references and pricing transparency.
